svg.title: Two-stage U-Net
svg.desc: Two-stage U-Net with mirrored convolution pairs and a centered bottleneck. Pooling arrows point straight down; deconvolution arrows point straight up. All spatial planes share a horizontal baseline. Concat displays encoder skip features on the left and deconvolution features on the right, retaining their true tensor channel indices. Spatial dimensions label the right and bottom edges of the front-right plane; channel count labels the stack-depth axis.

g.aria-label: 3 × 3 convolution · stride 1 · padding 1 · followed by ReLU. The activation selector chooses before or after ReLU.
g.title: 3 × 3 convolution · stride 1 · padding 1 · followed by ReLU. The activation selector chooses before or after ReLU.

g.aria-label: 2 × 2 max pooling · stride 2 · padding 0 · halves spatial resolution.
g.title: 2 × 2 max pooling · stride 2 · padding 0 · halves spatial resolution.
